Name: Crops Galore
Author: Sulfire2
Description:
Adds 6 new crops and 12 new fruit trees (all from my fictional world called Hamundis) 
[u][b]Spring Crops and Trees[/b][/u]
Mulhaz (3 days)

Aeram, Afdaff, Agaro, Ah'mez, Akamediam, Appavberry, Attikapato, Ayakayubra
[b][u]Summer Crops and Trees[/u][/b]
Celannic (6 days)
Stahzberry (6 days, reproduces)

Abiff, Adravil, Ajuku, Ansliberry, Arokotei, Avhuf, Awallhimm
[b][u]Fall Crops and Trees[/u][/b]
Celannic (6 days)
Wyiad (4 days)
Yzahn (5 days)

Acuri, Alzu, Aorumi, As'sam, Azazano
[b][u]Winter Crops and Trees[/u][/b]
Zohlberry (5 days, reproduces)
Tcthyiad (4 days)

Aaki, Airla, Amtarta, Aqinemes, Aufderal, Axofberry


More crops and trees will be coming in the future!

All CROP AND ITEM assets are my own, 
HOWEVER ALL ACTUALL TREE ASSETS ARE BORROWED FROM BONTER'S TREES AND BONSTER'S ODDI-TREES (both great mods, check them out)
